verdict.rationale: Pika's own materials say it offers an API ("Pika API Club: One API for 100+ leading video, image, audio, and LLM models," accessed through a membership program), so programmatic generation is a first-party capability. However, the evidence is only marketing one-liners: there is no API reference, no job-submission endpoint, and no description of status polling or asset retrieval. The MCP connector is an agent-integration channel, not a documented developer job API, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented API reference/endpoints, job submission and async status/polling flow, finished-asset retrieval/download mechanism, authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
